structure.opening_style: context-setting via industry trends or direct problem/solution framing
structure.section_organization: logical progression: Context -> Announcement/Solution -> Technical Deep Dive -> Customer Proof -> Conclusion
structure.code_integration: inline code blocks used as evidence of simplicity (e.g., SQL or Python snippets)
structure.conclusion_style: summary of benefits with direct links to documentation or next steps

phrases_to_avoid: Manual processes (framed as the negative state)

communication.value_proposition: combining the flexibility of data lakes with the governance and performance of data warehouses (Lakehouse), powered by AI
credibility_markers: Customer quotes (e.g., Corning, Xcel Energy, Lippert)
References to open source contributions (Spark, MLflow)
communication.technical_depth: deep but accessible; assumes familiarity with data engineering/data science concepts but explains new proprietary features clearly
